decisions.why: examples (Sample Preparation For Clinical Flow Cytometry, Cocktails And Kits, Lyse Reagents) are flow cytometry sample-prep reagents and kits, i.e. laboratory consumables used with lab analysers, not the analysers themselves

Un Series (Sysmex UN-Series urine particle analysers), Molecular Diagnostics Osna (OSNA molecular analyser) and Digital Imaging (digital cell morphology analyser) are all laboratory analyser/equipment products
Xn V Series (Sysmex XN-Series haematology analysers), Digital Imaging Solutions and Sysmex Veterinary Smear Workflow are all laboratory analyser/equipment products, matching Analysers & equipment
